observations.body: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Jesus recalls Moses lifting up the serpent in the wilderness.
observations.label: The serpent remembered

observations.body: Jesus takes one wilderness action—lifting the serpent—and uses it to speak of his own lifting up.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read John 3:12–16 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The comparison is explicit, but the two scenes and their forms of response remain distinct.
payload.title: The serpent remembered
